newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai central bank inject funds into money market.
newsitem.headline: Thai central bank inject funds into money market.

text.p: Thailand's central bank said on Monday it had injected up to 14.0 billion baht (US$560 million) into the money market to ease tight liquidity,.

Assistant Bank of Thailand (BOT) governor, Siri Ganjarerndee, told reporters the tight liquidity stemmed from continuing unfounded rumours about the financial health and liquidity positions of some, unidentified, finance companies in the country.
Some commercial banks were reluctant to lend money to some financial institutions because of the rumours, causing tighter liquidity conditions, he said.
The overnight interbank rate eased to 13.50-14.00 percent late on Monday compared with 14.00-14.50 percent in the morning and 12.50 percent late on Friday, dealers said.
However, some other dealers believe the rate could climb further later this week as short term money continues to flow out of the system.
